title: A Current for the Compass
author: P. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Oscar Lockridge, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
